scope: Future evidence-based assessment of productive rearranged J regions on public development data only
rationale: A germline F/ORF/P label is not equivalent to expression and productive rearrangement of a mature receptor. Current policy remains frozen; no candidate is automatically admitted by this plan.
requirements: Keep original IMGT F/ORF/P annotation and raw reference stops; never rewrite ORF as F.
Obtain directly observed complete paired mature variable sequences and construct linkage; no germline filling, inferred N/J bases or merging by CDR3/name alone.

For an upstream-stop reference, require primary observed rearranged nucleotide evidence to determine whether the stop is absent from the mature CDS; protein suffix compatibility alone is insufficient to infer a historical deletion or unique allele.
Require independent whole-input numbering, explicit alpha/beta pairing and source validation; unresolved gene/chain conflicts stay quarantined.
Keep endpoint-specific functional and affinity evidence separate; a functional assay negative is not a binding negative.
Apply the same atomic completeness and geometry QC after identity admission; do not use imputed atoms to make a pair eligible.
Maintain source/receptor separation, source-balanced hard controls and untouched independent acceptance; publish any protocol amendment before model fitting or evaluation.
